title: No published operation name for the rwb-source-data appraisal and asset product or for the rwb-case case-move answer
source: Architecture v5 slide 8; Ownership Map; TSD S5 T5.2 and T-A.1
section: s3 Preconditions; s12.2 REST operations consumed
description: The price-ladder step reads the appraisal and NPA asset facts (v_ace_valuation, v_ace_npa_asset in the legacy) and answers the case moves ROUND_OPEN and ASSET_HELD. No source document publishes the operation name of the rwb-source-data data-product read or of the case-move answer on rwb-case, and the C row of this slice in the plan is None.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-022 Endpoints table names only POST /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}/listings and GET /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}; TSD S5 T5.2 says calls go through published Java interfaces without an operation name; the Ownership Map lists no source-data product or case-move operation.
proposed: Declare both rows with the placeholder and their gap identifier, build against the documented shapes and their fakes on Day 1, and let P1 and P3 publish the names at the tag of RWB-S5-E4022-CON.

title: listing names no column for the per-round price that R-DIS-38 steps down
source: TSD S5 T3.1 and T3.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-38
description: R-DIS-38 is conditioned on price_at_round above floor_price, but the listing object of TSD S5 T3.1 carries id, asset_id, sale_channel, start_price, floor_price, round_no, listed_at and status only. No source names a column, a table or a reference-data row that holds the price of the current round or the ladder step itself.
evidence: TSD S5 T3.1 listing DF-SAL-001 to DF-SAL-008; R-DIS-38 condition in the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4; FSD S5 A2.13 lists the rule and no field.
proposed: Hold the per-round price against the round row the rounds story owns and record it as a gap of this service until the DB story or the LDM names a column; the ladder and its step are read as reference data with a version.

title: API-S5-004 is claimed by the pricing story and by the price step, and no source splits it
source: TSD S5 T-A.1 and T-A.2; FSD S5 A2.11 and A2.13; Ownership Map
section: s7 Acceptance criteria; s12.1 REST operations provided
description: POST /assets/{assetId}/listings is documented as setting the list price and floor and sending them for approval (FEAT-AST-11), while legacy RWB-E4-022 lists the same operation as its own and its AC3 resets the list and floor price inputs under R-DIS-17. No source says which story publishes the operation or whether the head of NPA approval of the floor belongs to the reset.
evidence: TSD S5 T-A.2 API-S5-004 purpose; FSD S5 A2.11 and A2.13; legacy RWB-E4-022 Endpoints table.
proposed: Declare the operation once in RWB-S5-E4022-CON for both stories; the pricing story owns the start price and the floor approval, and this step owns the reset of the inputs on an accepted re-appraisal and the step of the price at each round.

title: The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice
source: Plan draft of the run; FSD S5 A2.13; Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1 BR-027
description: The story rows of this slice carry an empty requirement list, so the slice traces to the feature FEAT-AST-13 and to BR-027 only, and the header requires the PRD reference to read Pending (C1).
evidence: Story row of RWB-S5-E4022-APP and RWB-S5-E4022-CON with reqs []; FSD S5 T8 lists REQ-S5-001 to REQ-S5-010 against other features only.
proposed: Trace the slice to FEAT-AST-13 of FSD S5 A2.13 and to BR-027 of the epic BRD until the PRD allocates requirement ids.

title: The step evaluates the DISPOSAL package while DP-04 is outside the pattern set of the slice
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04; story row patterns DP03, DP05, DP13, DP19; TSD S5 T4
description: R-DIS-38 and R-DIS-17 are evaluated against the DISPOSAL rule package, which DP-04 governs with H RWB-PLT-E1072-CON and C RWB-P7-E1073-CON. The pattern set of this slice names neither, and no source says whether the package load is a capability of the service template or a pattern of this slice.
evidence: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04 row; the patterns of RWB-S5-E4022-APP; FSD S5 A2.13.3.1 rule table.
proposed: Load the package in force through the service template, add no H row for the platform rules kit in this slice, and record the reading so the next realignment of the pattern set can confirm it.
